rename.from: Rest client egnores default tls configuration
rename.to: Rest client ignores default tls configuration

issue.title: Fix Javadoc for TLS configuration of REST Client

body:
Thanks for the thorough reproducer!

What you are seeing is the expected behavior (implemented across all clients that support TLS), but I see that our Javadoc is incorrect, so I opened https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/47712 to fix that
The reason for not using the default config is explained in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/adr/0004-using-the-tls-registry-for-clients.adoc

@geoand , @cescoffier thank you!

I presume, that this beahavior affects not just rest client, but other clients (eg grpc) as well. Maybe we should put this warning into the guide (https://quarkus.io/guides/tls-registry-reference)?

> I presume, that this beahavior affects not just rest client, but other clients (eg grpc) as wel

Yup, that is correct
